calls.statement:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.holdout_pct, c.mailing_list_size, c.holdout_size,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS holdout_distinct
FROM dim_campaign c ORDER BY start_date

WITH exp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM exp) AS exposed_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM exp)) AS holdout_also_exposed,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS holdout_unknown_member,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) AS exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) AS bak_rows,
 (SELECT holdout_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) AS bak_holdout

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS holdout_rows, count(DISTINCT h.member_id) AS holdout_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (SELECT min(join_date) FROM dim_member d WHERE d.member_id=h.member_id) > DATE '2025-11-30' THEN h.member_id END) AS joined_after,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member d WHERE d.member_id=h.member_id AND d.marketing_consent AND d.valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-30' AND d.valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24') THEN h.member_id END) AS no_consent_in_window
FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=15

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, count(DISTINCT h.member_id) AS held_out_members
FROM dim_campaign c JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Black Week 2025'
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
